# Documentation Standards

Apply the repository-wide guidance in [Copilot instructions](../copilot-instructions.md).

- Keep the README accurate for the current product scope, development commands, data behavior, and deployment workflow.
- Explain user-visible assumptions and units consistently with the calculator's canonical centimetre model and current results UI.
- Prefer concise, task-oriented prose and working relative links. Update documentation when a change affects setup, behavior, validation, or contributor workflow.
- Do not document planned behavior as implemented, or promise support for features the project intentionally excludes.
